title: Immigration: Live and Work in Ghana as a Non-Citizen
description: The ordered immigration and expatriate pathway to secure entry visas, Non-Citizen biometric cards, employment authorisations, residence permits, and quota allocations from the Ghana Immigration Service (GIS).

steps.title: Secure Entry Visa or eVisa Pre-Approval
steps.why: Non-ECOWAS foreign nationals must obtain a valid single or multiple entry visa prior to departure or an approved emergency visa on arrival.
steps.do_this_when: At least 3-4 weeks prior to travelling to Ghana.

options.label: Official Ghana eVisa Application Portal
options.notes: Direct electronic visa application portal for visitors and business delegates.

options.label: Emergency Entry Visa on Arrival Pre-Approval
options.notes: Sponsor-submitted application for entry clearance at Kotoka International Airport.

steps.title: Enroll for Non-Citizen Ghana Card (FIMS)
steps.why: The Foreigner Identification Management System (FIMS) card is legally required for all non-citizens resident in Ghana for opening bank accounts, tax filings, and obtaining residence permits.
steps.do_this_when: Immediately upon arrival in Ghana or before applying for immigration permits.

options.label: Non-Citizen Ghana Card Registration (FIMS)
options.notes: Mandatory biometric identification for all resident non-citizens.

steps.title: Apply for Work Permit Authorisation
steps.why: Under Immigration Act 2000 (Act 573), non-citizens cannot engage in employment or business without a work permit sponsored by an incorporated Ghanaian entity.
steps.do_this_when: Sponsored by your hiring entity before commencement of duties.

options.label: Ghana Immigration Service Work Permit Division
options.notes: Requirements for corporate work authorisations and employment contracts.

steps.title: Submit Residence Permit Application
steps.why: Authorises the foreign national to reside lawfully in Ghana for an initial duration of 1 to 4 years, subject to renewal.
steps.do_this_when: Following grant of the work permit or alongside company quota approvals.

options.label: Ghana Immigration Service Residence Permits
options.notes: Official permits portal for residence endorsements.

steps.title: Expatriate Immigrant Quota Allocation
steps.why: Enterprises with foreign capital registered under GIPC or Ministry of the Interior require automatic quota slots to place foreign directors and technical executives.
steps.do_this_when: When establishing foreign company leadership in Ghana.

options.label: Immigrant Quota Allocation Services
options.notes: Expatriate quota allocations linked to GIPC and corporate investments.

steps.title: Dependant Residence Permit (Spouse & Children)
steps.why: Allows legal entry, residence, and schooling for spouses and children under 18 linked to the primary work permit holder.
steps.do_this_when: When relocating family dependents to Ghana.

options.label: Dependant Residence Permit Application
options.notes: Requirements for proof of kinship, marriage certificates, and medical examinations.
